title: Pete Davidson Teases Future Tattoos After “Brutal” Removal Process
text:
Pete Davidson Details Tattoo Removal in New Interview 
 News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop Exclusive Pete Davidson Teases Future Tattoos After “Brutal” Removal Process
 As Saturday Night Live alum Pete Davidson continues his tattoo removal journey, he shared insight into the “brutal” process in an exclusive E! News interview at the How to Rob a Bank premiere. 
 By Olivia Evans , Carli Rappaport Nov 11, 2026 6:05 PM | Updated 6 hours ago Tags Movies Exclusives Celebrities Nicholas Hoult Pete Davidson Link Copied Add E! News to Google Watch : Pete Davidson Teases Future Tattoos After “Brutal” Removal Process Pete Davidson   is wearing his heart on his sleeve—just not in ink.
 As the  Saturday Night Live   alum continues his tattoo removal journey, which he began in 2020, he shared a cheeky update about where he stands in the process. 
 “It’s brutal,” Davidson told E! News in exclusive interview at the How to Rob a Bank  New York premiere alongside costar  Nicholas Hoult . “I’ve only been wearing for sweaters for, like, six months so you don’t know what’s going on under there.”
 But while Davidson—dad to daughter  Scottie , 11 months, with ex  Elsie Hewitt —has gotten his once sleeved-up arms to nearly completely bare skin, the  King of Staten Island  star quipped of his tattoos, “You never know, they might come back.”
 That wasn’t the only teasing, however, he provided. 
 While the whole world seems to be waiting to know who the next  James Bond  star might be , the 32-year-old joked fans shouldn’t look much further than Davidson—Pete Davidson. 
 read Pete Davidson Gives Rare Shoutout to Ex Elsie Hewitt After Outing With Daughter Scottie Ignoring Hoult at his side—who has been rumored to be circling the role alongside  Callum Turner ,  Jack Lowden  and  Josh O’Connor —the  Bodies Bodies Bodies  alum revealed, “It’s going to be me.”
 “Plot twist,” Davidson quipped. “I will be the first American James Bond.”
 Jokes aside though, Davidson offered his full support to Hoult—who remained as elusive on the topic as the character itself. 
 “If anyone should get it, it’s this guy next to me,” Davidson mused. “He’s the best guy for the job.”
 And that’s not the only role Davidson says Hoult would ace. In fact, the comedian admitted his costar—who shares three kids with wife  Bryana Holly —has been a great role model during Davidson's his first year of fatherhood. 
 Taylor Hill/FilmMagic “Very supportive and checks in,” Davidson said of Hoult. “We both check in on each other’s families and see how they’re doing because that’s what friends do.”
 Meanwhile, Davidson previously shared that his entire life perspective has shifted nearly a year after welcoming his baby girl. 
 “My priorities have shifted in just that becoming a dad is great for so many reasons,” Davidson told E! News in an interview earlier this year , “but it just made me realize the stuff that I cared about so much don't actually matter.”
 The Bupkis alum considered that becoming a dad has “calmed” him. As he put it, “I'm just happy where I am.”
 While Davidson is cooling down and removing his tattoos, other stars have debuted quite the body art over the years. Keep reading for the most inked up celebrities, and don’t miss  How to Rob a Bank  when it hits theaters Nov. 13.

 After shaving off some of his hair, the Aquaman star revealed a new head tattoo in September 2022 that he said has been "20 years in the making."
 JoJo Siwa/Instagram JoJo Siwa
 The "Karma" singer unveiled a bicep tattoo of a teddy bear with angel wings in June 2024. The design was a nod to the cover art of her Guilty Pleasure album.
 Elle King/Instagram Elle King
 In April 2024, the "Ex's and Oh's" singer debuted a new tattoo—located on her rear—that paid tribute to some very important men in her life.
 "I always said I'd get my baby daddys name tattooed on my butt…so I did," Elle, who is the daughter of Rob Schneider , wrote on Instagram. "I got 'brethren' for the men helping me raise my son. I love you guys so much, I wouldn't want to do life without yall."
